description: A shell script designed to test git submodule commands and outputs, including various options and scenarios such as recursive operation, quiet mode, cached status, and error handling.

methods.name: setup_sub
methods.description: Sets up a new submodule directory by cloning the current repository into a specified directory and adding it as a submodule.

methods.name: normalize_status
methods.description: Normalizes the output of git submodule status by replacing hash values with a placeholder.
